result.finding: No pre-built JAR files are present; Dockerfiles are generated at deploy time by scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh. Based on the base image (eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine ~200MB) and the expected Spring Boot fat JAR sizes (web: ~80-100MB with Thymeleaf, Spring MVC, AMQP, AWS SDK S3, JPA; worker: ~70-90MB), estimated total image sizes are approximately 290-310MB for the web image and 275-295MB for the worker image. No additional OS packages are installed in either Dockerfile.
evidence: Base image: eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine (~200MB, JRE-only Alpine variant)
Dockerfiles generated by scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh — single-stage, no additional apk/apt installs
Web module dependencies: Spring Boot Web, Thymeleaf, Spring AMQP, AWS SDK S3 v2.25.13, Spring Data JPA, PostgreSQL driver (~80-100MB fat JAR)
Worker module dependencies: Spring Boot, Spring AMQP, AWS SDK S3 v2.25.13, Spring Data JPA, PostgreSQL driver, Jackson (~70-90MB fat JAR)
No built JAR artifacts found in target/ directories (project not yet built)
values: Application JAR layer: ~70-100MB (Spring Boot fat JAR)
